name: Lint

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'challenges/**'
      - 'scripts/**'
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write
  actions: write

jobs:
  python:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install Python linting tools
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install black isort flake8

      - name: Run black
        run: black --check .

      - name: Run isort
        run: isort --check-only .

      - name: Run flake8
        run: flake8 .

  cpp:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install clang-format
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y clang-format

      - name: Check C++/CUDA formatting
        run: |
          find . -regex '.*\.\(cpp\|hpp\|cu\|cuh\|h\)' -print0 | \
          xargs -0 clang-format -style=file -n -Werror

  mojo:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Mojo
        run: |
          curl -L https://github.com/dojo-lang/mojo/releases/download/v0.7.0/mojo-0.7.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz | tar xz
          echo "$(pwd)/mojo-0.7.0/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Validate Mojo files
        run: |
          find . -name '*.mojo' -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
            mojo check "$file" || exit 1
          done
